Global SEO services refer to the process of international search engine optimization to increase organic traffic from a variety of countries. This helps search engines such as Google identify the specific countries you need to target and the languages your business uses in those countries. Unlike local SEO, which focuses on a localized audience group in your language, international SEO services will need to optimize the website for different languages and countries. Those customers are more likely to search for a product or service in their native tongue, which is why an international SEO company can help improve the business visibility in global search engines. A global SEO company also needs to provide multilingual SEO services, ensuring that the language used in a specific target country matches the preference expressed by international customers. It is important to mention that, depending on the targeted countries, international SEO services may not always require a change of language. Understand your market approach No two international SEO marketing strategies are the same. The strategy you need will depend entirely on your company and target audience. The international SEO agency will focus primarily on a language-based segmentation strategy if the business maintains the same range of products or services across an international market. This will ensure the content is optimized for individual international target groups or languages but remains the same across the board. On the other hand, if the business provides different services or products in different markets, it makes sense to approach each country separately. The international SEO strategy focuses on building dedicated country websites with their own global SEO approaches. Do Your Research Before Approaching A New Market When you reach a new market, you need to understand how your audience and your competitors behave in the market. The most costly mistake a business can make is to apply local audience knowledge and behaviors to an international market. When you partner with an international SEO agency, you work with SEO experts who can help research who your audience is. The research typically focuses on keyword research, traffic monitoring, and understanding how people search for similar products and services. This is the first step of your international SEO strategy. As a newcomer to an international market, you are likely to face two types of competition. First of all, local businesses can present strong competition in terms of local SEO visibility, brand awareness, and market experience. Additionally, you can also face known brands that implement international SEO marketing, and these brands could already be competitors in your national market. That’s precisely why it’s essential to work with an international SEO company and protect your global presence. Determine The Right Keywords For Each Country When you target a market in a different language, your keywords will automatically change, even if the products remain the same. “Women’s shirts” in an en-us region become “Frauen Blusen” in a de-de market, for example. However, more than an exercise of translation, international SEO requires transcreating the keywords to the relevant search terms used by the audience to find similar products or services. Additionally, some industry sectors like IT tend to keep English keywords even when English isn’t the targeted country’s language. An international SEO company expert’s role is to determine the term(s) used by the local users and the unique search patterns for every keyword. Sometimes, the search patterns can differ significantly even when the terms are the same. For example, “Mother’s Day” in the US remains the same in the UK. However, the months during which users will search relevant products are different. It is also worth mentioning that international SEO services should also focus on monthly search volumes in the relevant target markets. A popular keyword in one market could attract less international traffic once transcreated for a new audience. Introduce New Local SEO Signals For Specific Targets Aside from the typical international SEO services for Google, the role of a global SEO partner is to ensure your website is equipped to achieve the best possible ranking in a specific international market. A local hosting solution can prove highly effective in improving localization signals. Additionally, while Google is the number one search engine in the US, it isn’t necessarily the preferred search engine for your targeted location. For example, South Korea prefers Naver, often called “the Google of South Korea”. Russian users are more familiar with Yandex than Google. Chinese searches happen on Baidu. These search engines have different algorithm and ranking factors. Consequently, it makes sense to tailor the international search engine optimization strategy to the most relevant search engines in each country. Set hreflang Attributes The hreflang attribute informs the search engine about your content language and the geo-targeting for your website. The hreflang attribute is essential for international search engine optimization because: It prevents duplicate content penalties for regions that use almost the same language, such as the US and the UK, en-us vs. en-gb. It clarifies your geo-targeting for search engines, so your website can appear for relevant searches in the relevant region and language. FAQs on International SEO Services When do I need to consider international SEO services? We strongly recommend working with an internal SEO agency when your website receives a large volume of international visitors or/and when you wish to reach out to international audiences. The process will target users who browse in a different language and are in a different country. Do I need to set up different domains and websites for multilingual SEO? We recommend three options for international SEO services, depending on your needs: > You set unique domains or unique country code top-level domains (ccTLD) for each geo-location: yourdomain.au, yourdomain.fr, yourdomain.es, etc. > You use subdomains for geo-targeting: au.yourdomain.com, fr.yourdomain.com, ch.yourdomain.com, etc. > You use subdirectories to specify the relevant country and language: domain.com/au, domain.com/fr, domain.com/ch, etc. Additionally, the implementation of hreflang attributes will also support effective geo-targeting for multilingual SEO services. How are international SEO services different from translation services? Translation services transcribe your content across many languages, but they do not enhance your SEO strategy. A translated website is not optimized for international rankings. At SEOReseller, we make sure your global SEO strategy matches the search terms used by your audience, and displays the relevant localization signals for ranking purposes. Can I use international SEO services when the country is the same but languages are different? Yes, you can use multilingual website optimization within the same region.
